title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode22 Right Here With You

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What's the matter? You don't look well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
In that case, why don't you rest here awhile?
You can write some music and I'll keep you co—

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm not going to write any more music.
I don't want to do anything.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No. The opposite. Nothing ever happens.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Even writing songs as OWN hasn't helped me find myself.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Nothing helps, no matter how much I search.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Perhaps if I sing your special song, you'll feel better—

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That song isn't enough. It wasn't able to save me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But it's not just that song. None of the songs I've heard have helped me in my search.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why don't you try closing your eyes for a bit, then?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I do it myself sometimes. It helps me relax.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I remember doing that as a kid.
I would imagine all sorts of things.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Well... I would think about the best ways to make my parents happy or to get my friends to like me more.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But in imagining all of that, I forgot about my own dreams and the things I liked to do.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I've searched so many times, but it never helps.
No matter what I do, I still can't remember.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The only thing I can do to help her right now is...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu. I'm right here with you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll make sure to stay with you until you're able to find yourself.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (All I can do is be here with her, but what she really needs is...)
